name: gsl-test-kit
description: Checks for every GSL Canvas build: syntax, server render, browser. Not part of the app.

scripts.check: node syntax.js && node compile.js && node build.js && node rules.js && node lint.js && node render.js snap && node golden.js && node empty.js && node future.js
scripts.bundle: cd browser && node bundle.js entry.js app.bundle.js
scripts.tap:full: cd browser && timeout 570 node tap_t.js --full all --max 550
